propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share an identical 1M context window, so escalation from sonnet to opus gains zero additional capacity and guarantees a repeated failure at higher cost.

Silent failure: the escalation reports moving to a larger model; the retry fails with the same context-limit error; no trace indicates the two rungs were equal-capacity, leading to false diagnosis ('even opus could not fit it' instead of 'we never escalated').

Both declared window values (sonnet 1M, opus 1M) are verified correct against the provider's live Models API max_input_tokens field, so the defect is in consumption (escalation loop logic), not in the table itself.

The fix introduces escalation_rungs() to filter models_at_or_above() by removing rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, preventing no-op escalations while preserving all other consumption paths (models_at_or_above, largest_window_tokens, model-class vocabulary remain unchanged).
Both context-limit retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs instead of models_at_or_above to prevent the silent repeated failure.
